title: Moove raises $250M to become the backbone of the robotaxi industry
excerpt: Moove is scaling up the autonomous vehicle fleet management side of its business and plans to someday own, not just manage, Waymo robotaxis.
content_html:
Moove’s evolution from a vehicle financing startup to ride-hailing and deliveries in Africa to one that also owns autonomous vehicles may seem like a leap. But co-founder and co-CEO Ladi Delano said the experience in financing and human-driven ride-hailing fleets was the ideal training ground for its latest pursuit.

And now it has raised $250 million at a $2.1 billion valuation to scale that business.

The company, founded in 2020 in Nigeria and now headquartered in Dubai, said Mubadala Investment Company led this latest Series C round, with Woven Capital and Ion Pacific as co-leads.

Moove is still very much in the human-driven ride-hailing business. It owns and operates a 42,000-vehicle ride-hailing fleet across 14 countries. The company, which employs 3,300 people globally, also still provides vehicle financing to gig drivers.

Its expansion into autonomous vehicles started in early 2023 after evaluating the industry and its four main players in this nascent ecosystem: the AV developers, vehicle manufacturers, marketplaces like Uber, and the consumer. None of these players want to “own the metal,” Delano told TechCrunch, referring to the vehicles.

“In this world, who owns the vehicle? Who operates the vehicle? Who orchestrates the vehicle? Who does the servicing, the maintenance? Who does the lost property? Who does the cleaning?” Delano asked. It became clear, he added, that Moove’s experience managing large fleets and providing financing could translate to autonomous vehicle operations.

“Let’s create a product where we own, operate, and orchestrate autonomous vehicles, and let’s go and find partners to do it with — and that’s essentially what we did,” Delano said. “In 2023, we started talking to every single AV company you could imagine, and as you know — God would have it, luck would have it — we managed to partner with Waymo first.”

Moove is the fleet operator for Waymo in Phoenix, Miami, and Las Vegas, and in the future, London. The company doesn’t own the Waymo vehicles, but it plans to. Moove intends to use debt financing to purchase the robotaxis. Delano didn’t share a timeline for when Moove will start buying Waymo robotaxis. He did say Moove already owns robotaxi vehicles from another AV developer, although he wouldn’t disclose which company.

“Ultimately our vision is to own, you know, hundreds of thousands of vehicles,” he said, referring to robotaxis.

This latest funding will be used to scale the company’s autonomous vehicle fleet management business, including hiring about 350 people. (Delano said its traditional mobility business is set to achieve full profitability this year.) Some of the capital will also go toward developing automated depots that it calls “nests.” These “nests” will be able to operate around the clock and use robotics to automate vehicle charging, maintenance, and servicing.

Moove has about 15 depots that are in some stage of development. Delano wouldn’t say when its automated, “lights-out” depots would come online, noting that this is a future product.

Other backers in the round include BlueCrest Capital Management, Sona Asset Management, and Raptor Group, BlackRock, MUFG, Franklin Templeton, Uber, Left Lane, Silverbacks Holdings, Square Associates, The Latest Ventures, Endeavor Catalyst, and the Ontario Power Generation Pension Plan.

Kirsten Korosec is a reporter and editor who has covered the future of transportation from EVs and autonomous vehicles to urban air mobility and in-car tech for more than a decade. content_html_zh:
Moove 从一家汽车融资初创公司发展为非洲的网约车和送货服务，再到拥有自动驾驶汽车的公司，这似乎是一个飞跃。 但联合创始人兼联合首席执行官拉迪·德拉诺(Ladi Delano)表示，融资和人力驱动的叫车车队方面的经验是其最新追求的理想训练场。

现在，该公司已以 21 亿美元的估值筹集了 2.5 亿美元，以扩大该业务。

该公司于 2020 年在尼日利亚成立，现总部位于迪拜。该公司表示，Mubadala Investment Company 领投了最新的 C 轮融资，Woven Capital 和 Ion Pacific 担任联席领投方。

Moove 仍然主要致力于人力驱动的叫车业务。 它在 14 个国家拥有并运营着 42,000 辆网约车车队。 该公司在全球拥有 3,300 名员工，仍然为零工司机提供车辆融资。

在评估了该行业及其在这个新兴生态系统中的四个主要参与者（自动驾驶开发商、汽车制造商、Uber 等市场和消费者）后，该公司于 2023 年初开始向自动驾驶汽车领域扩张。 德拉诺在谈到车辆时告诉 TechCrunch，这些玩家都不想“拥有这些金属”。

“在这个世界上，谁拥有车辆？ 谁操作车辆？ 谁协调车辆？ 谁负责维修、保养？ 失物归谁？ 谁打扫卫生？” 德拉诺问道。 他补充说，很明显，Moove 管理大型车队和提供融资的经验可以转化为自动驾驶汽车运营。

德拉诺说：“让我们创建一个产品，让我们拥有、运营和协调自动驾驶汽车，然后寻找合作伙伴来实现这一目标——这基本上就是我们所做的。” “2023 年，我们开始与你能想象到的每一家 AV 公司进行交谈，正如你所知，上帝会眷顾你，运气也会眷顾你，我们首先成功与 Waymo 合作。”

Moove 是 Waymo 在菲尼克斯、迈阿密和拉斯维加斯以及未来伦敦的车队运营商。 该公司并不拥有 Waymo 车辆，但计划拥有。 Moove 打算使用债务融资来购买机器人出租车。 Delano 没有透露 Moove 何时开始购买 Waymo 机器人出租车的时间表。 他确实表示 Moove 已经拥有另一家自动驾驶汽车开发商的机器人出租车车辆，但他没有透露是哪家公司。

“最终我们的愿景是拥有数十万辆车辆，”他指的是机器人出租车。

这笔最新资金将用于扩大该公司的自动驾驶车队管理业务，包括雇用约 350 名员工。 （德拉诺表示，其传统移动业务今年将实现全面盈利。） 部分资金还将用于开发被称为“巢穴”的自动化仓库。 这些“巢”将能够全天候运行，并使用机器人技术实现车辆充电、维护和服务的自动化。

Moove 大约有 15 个正处于开发阶段的软件仓库。 德拉诺没有透露其自动化“熄灯”仓库何时上线，并指出这是未来的产品。

此轮融资的其他支持者包括 BlueCrest Capital Management、Sona Asset Management、Raptor Group、BlackRock、MUFG、Franklin Templeton、Uber、Left Lane、Silverbacks Holdings、Square Associates、The Late Ventures、Endeavor Catalyst 和 Ontario Power Generation Pension Plan。
